sentences.text:
These petitions coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
Since the controversy involved in these cases are identical in nature, therefore, these writ petitions were analogously heard and being decided by this common order.

The petitioners have filed these petitions under Article 226 of the Constitution of India challenging the action of the respondents, whereby they have constructed a wall in front of their houses / shops.
02. According to the petitioners, earlier also most of the area of their land was acquired for widening of the road.
The respondents are constructing the wall without leaving any space in front of the house and excess to the road from their houses.
03. The respondents were called upon to file reply.

Respondents No.1 & 2 filed a reply by submitting that in order to develop Mahakal Lok Parisar at Ujjain, notifications under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 were issued for acquiring the land for widening of the road.
Since the houses of the petitioners are coming into acquisition, therefore, their names were included in the award dated 05.10.2021 and compensation was awarded accordingly.

Irfan Mansoori (petitioner in W.P. No.22334 of 2023) was awarded the compensation of Rs.3,12,682/- and Zahida Bee (petitioner in W.P. No.22336 of 2023) was awarded compensation of Rs.3,31,776/- vide award dated Irfan Mansoori vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168364365/
2 05.10.2021.
03.

sentences.text: The Sub Division Officer, present in person before this Court submits that now fresh notifications have been issued for acquiring their entire houses and land and the award is likely to be passed.

It is further submitted that now it came to his knowledge that in the revenue record, the said land is in the name of Waqf Board and not in the name of petitioners, therefore, they are only entitled to get compensation for their houses.
So far as the temporary shed constructed by the petitioners is concerned, after acquisition, they shall be entitled for compensation, unless they get their name mutated in the revenue record.
04. The petitioners have not challenged the award dated 05.10.2021 and now remaining land is also being acquired for development of Mahakal Lok Parisar.
After acquisition of the land, the respondents are constructing boundary wall in order to avoid encroachment and inconvenience to the vehicles and visitors who come to Mahakal Temple.
Now the petitioners are require to apply for mutation of their names in order to get compensation for their land.

The Land Acquisition Officer,
while passing the award shall calculate the compensation for the land, structure and everything.
After decision of the title, the amount, so assessed by the Land Acquisition Officer, shall be released to the land owners.
05. With the aforesaid, Writ Petitions stand disposed of.
Let a copy of this order be kept in the connected petition also.
(VIVEK RUSIA) JUDGE Ravi Irfan Mansoori vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168364365/
